class.name: FellowTraversal3D
class.brief_description: FellowEngine: mantling, vaulting, hanging from ledges and climbing ladders for a character's body — a ledge found with physics queries, the body moved onto it (or over a thin obstacle) along a path that keeps its capsule clear, or hung from it and moved along it.

method.name: cancel
method.description: Ends the mantle in progress where the body is (its velocity zero); [signal mantle_cancelled] is emitted.

method.name: climb_up
method.description: Hanging: climbs onto the top now if there is room (the same as pushing at the wall).

method.name: find_ledge
method.description: Looks for a ledge in [param direction] (by default the intent, else the body's velocity, else its -Z) without starting anything. The result: [code]kind[/code] (a [enum Kind]), [code]reason[/code] (why it is [constant KIND_BLOCKED], [constant KIND_TOO_HIGH] or [constant KIND_NONE]), [code]edge[/code] (the top's edge on the wall's face), [code]inward[/code] (horizontal, into the wall), [code]top_normal[/code], [code]height[/code] (the top over the feet), [code]target[/code] (where the feet go: on the top, or the vault's landing), [code]depth[/code] (a vaulted obstacle's), [code]open_below[/code] (the body could walk on under it) and [code]collider[/code].

method.name: get_action
method.description: The mantle in progress ([constant KIND_LOW], [constant KIND_HIGH] or [constant KIND_VAULT]), or [constant KIND_NONE].

method.name: get_climb_input
method.description: See [method set_climb_input].

method.name: get_global_stats
method.description: Every traversal's work since the last [method reset_global_stats]: [code]checks[/code] and [code]check_usec[/code] (the ledges looked for), [code]steps[/code] and [code]step_usec[/code] (the physics frames of mantles moving bodies), [code]mantles_low[/code], [code]mantles_high[/code], [code]vaults[/code], [code]poses[/code] and [code]pose_usec[/code] (the [FellowTraversalPose3D]s' poses). The debugger's Monitors tab shows their time a frame as "FellowEngine/Traversal time".

method.name: get_intent
method.description: The direction set by [method set_intent].

method.name: get_ladder
method.description: The [FellowLadder3D] the body is on, or [code]null[/code].

method.name: get_last_check
method.description: The last check's result (automatic, [method find_ledge] or [method try_mantle]), as [method find_ledge] returns it.

method.name: get_pose_targets
method.description: What the body's pose follows this physics frame (global space), for a pose of one's own: [code]active[/code], [code]kind[/code], [code]progress[/code], [code]inward[/code], [code]hand_left[/code], [code]hand_right[/code], [code]hand_weights[/code] (a [Vector2]: left, right), [code]foot_left[/code], [code]foot_right[/code], [code]foot_weights[/code], [code]foot_follow[/code] (how far each foot's target moves down with the hips), [code]lean[/code] (radians, towards the wall), [code]hips_drop[/code] (meters the hips may hang below the capsule's place), [code]clip[/code] and [code]clip_time[/code].

method.name: get_progress
method.description: The mantle's progress, 0 to 1 (0 when none is in progress).

method.name: is_active
method.description: [code]true[/code] while a mantle moves the body.

method.name: is_hanging
method.description: Whether the body hangs from a ledge.

method.name: is_on_ladder
method.description: Whether the body is on a ladder.

method.name: release
method.description: Hanging or on a ladder: lets go (the body falls, pushed a little away).

method.name: reset_global_stats
method.description: Sets the counters of [method get_global_stats] to zero.

method.name: set_climb_input
method.description: On a ladder: up (1) or down (-1), from the controller's own input; 0: from the intent ([method set_intent]: up, or towards the ladder, climbs).

method.name: set_intent
method.description: The way the player wants to go (the input, in global space), set by the controller every physics frame: the automatic mantle checks that way, and a body pressed against a wall (its velocity into it lost to the slide) still mantles. A zero vector: the body's velocity is used.

method.name: try_hang
method.description: Hangs from the ledge in [param direction] (the intent's or the velocity's when zero) if one is in reach whose top it could climb or is blocked from climbing: a jump's grab done by the controller. Returns whether it hangs.

method.name: try_ladder
method.description: Takes a [FellowLadder3D] in reach (in front of it, the body going towards it; or at its top, going over it). Returns whether it did.

method.name: try_mantle
method.description: Checks for a ledge as [method find_ledge] does and starts the mantle or vault it allows (also one the body could walk under); [code]false[/code] when there is none, a mantle is in progress, the traversal is disabled, or the body is in the air without [member grab_in_air]. For a mantle on a button with [member auto_mantle] off.

members.member: The body turns to face the wall (its -Z into it) over the first 30 % of the mantle.
Checks every physics frame while the body moves (or has an intent) and starts what it finds. Off: only [method try_mantle] starts one.
The horizontal speed under which the automatic check does not run (without an intent).
The body moved; by default the parent.
The physics frames from one automatic check to the next while nothing was in reach (staggered between traversals); with a wall in reach, every frame.

The bone whose position track in the clips is the root's motion: sampled, its rise scaled to the ledge's height and its advance to the distance onto the top (or the landing), it becomes the body's path (kept out of the wall until the root has risen); [FellowTraversalPose3D] takes the displacement out of the bone's pose. Empty: the procedural path, the clip only posing the body.
The physics layers the queries see (walls, tops, the room for the capsule).
Draws the last ledge found (its edge and where the capsule goes; green when it can be climbed, red when not) and the mantle's path.
Off: no check, no mantle (one in progress is cancelled).
A [CharacterBody3D]'s speed into the ledge when a mantle ends (a vault keeps its entry speed if that is higher).

In the air (not on the floor, not rising faster than 1 m/s), ledges are grabbed up to 0.5 m higher than [member max_height] over the feet (hanging, the feet are lower). Vaults are not started in the air.

In the air, hangs from a ledge it cannot climb (no room on its top: a ceiling, an overhang) when the edge is about [member hang_reach] over its feet; and with [member hang_first], from every ledge it could climb.
In the air, hangs from ledges it could climb too, and climbs only when asked (pushing at the wall, up, or [method climb_up]).
Hanging, the hands' height over the feet (the body hangs this far below the edge, its capsule [member reach_distance]-free of the top).
The clip played for a [constant KIND_HIGH] mantle (its length is the mantle's).
A procedural [constant KIND_HIGH] mantle's time for a 1.8 m ledge (scaled with the square root of the height, 0.85 to 1.15 times).
How far in front of a ladder (past the capsule's radius) the body takes it.
Climbing speed on ladders, in m/s, at full input.
Takes the [FellowLadder3D]s the body goes towards (see [FellowLadder3D]).
The clip played for a [constant KIND_LOW] mantle (its length is the mantle's).
A procedural [constant KIND_LOW] mantle's time for a 1 m ledge (scaled with the square root of the height, 0.85 to 1.2 times).
Tops up to this height over the feet are [constant KIND_LOW] mantles, higher ones [constant KIND_HIGH].
The highest top climbed from the ground ([member grab_in_air] adds 0.5 m in the air).
A steeper top is [constant KIND_BLOCKED] ([code]"slope"[/code]).
The largest angle between the way the body goes and into the wall; a wall turned farther is passed by.
Lower obstacles are the character's own to step over or jump.
How far beyond the capsule a wall is looked for.

Hanging, the speed along the ledge at full intent, in m/s: the body follows the edge as it turns (up to 50 degrees at a step) and steps (0.3 m), and stops where it ends, at a gap, or at something in the way.
Vaults over thin obstacles.
The clip played for a [constant KIND_VAULT] (its length is the vault's).
A procedural vault's time.
An obstacle whose far side drops within this depth (at least 0.25 m below its top) can be vaulted.
The highest obstacle vaulted.
At this speed or more a thin obstacle with room on it is vaulted rather than mantled.

signal.name: hang_finished
signal.description: Emitted when the body stops hanging: [param climbed] if it climbs onto the top (a mantle starts), else it let go.

signal.name: hang_started
signal.description: Emitted when the body starts hanging from a ledge ([param ledge]: as [method find_ledge]'s).

signal.name: ladder_finished
signal.description: Emitted when the body leaves a ladder: [param at_top] if it climbs off at the top (a mantle starts), else at the foot or let go.

signal.name: ladder_started
signal.description: Emitted when the body takes a [param ladder].

signal.name: mantle_cancelled
signal.description: A mantle of [param kind] (a [enum Kind]) ended before its end: [method cancel], [member enabled] turned off, the traversal left the tree.

signal.name: mantle_finished
signal.description: A mantle of [param kind] (a [enum Kind]) ended with the body on the top or the landing.

signal.name: mantle_started
signal.description: A mantle of [param kind] (a [enum Kind]) began; [param ledge] is the check's result, as [method find_ledge] returns it.

constants.constant: Nothing to climb in reach (or no wall facing the way the body goes).
A mantle onto a top up to [member low_max_height].
A mantle onto a top up to [member max_height] (pulled up from a hang).
Over a thin obstacle up to [member vault_max_height].
A wall with no top below [member max_height] (or the ceiling over the body).
A top, but no room for the capsule on it, above the body or over the edge, or a top too steep (the reason says which).
